reviewSummary: 本源21张新面板PNG/4表已实际查看；五主题目录层级/空书签/搜索首屏、深色砖红左滑删除/删除后重开为空、搜索结果/无匹配及稳定跳转PNG可读。两条原录屏89.80s/63.64s全部1fps总览11表，以及目录入场33帧、左滑13帧、清空键盘17帧共63原始VFR帧/7表已查看，保留源PTS、无fps滤镜或插值。113张旧功能PNG及其余16阅读/5书库录屏保留而未逐看。本片加载/重开/搜索跳转片尾spinner与渐显不作为稳态正文验收；旧正文标题/菜单安全区、全动效及手机FPS不追认。
limitations: Only21 changed panel PNGs were manually reviewed;113 other reader captures retain hashes and remain unreviewed this run.
Two of18 reader recordings reviewed; other16 reader and five library recordings retained, not claimed manually inspected.
One-frame-per-second overviews are navigation summaries; only the listed63 original VFR frames received consecutive-frame review, without interpolation.
Startup/reopen and final search jump show spinner/fade, not a claim of always-present steady text. Separate stable jump screenshot is readable.
Existing underlying reader header/chapter-title overlap and prior pause/safe-area/capture limits remain independent open issues.
System keyboard and sheet movement is native; no phone FPS, energy, memory or all-gesture performance measurement was performed.
Ordinary signed/TrollStore device acceptance, physical keyboard/IME providers, Dynamic Type/VoiceOver/reduced-motion/contrast/rotation matrix remain pending.
Old independent font reopen failures and long WebContent launch timings are retained; this full pass does not prove their root cause fixed.
